subject: Exec preflight: OKR status + QBR action list
raw:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.example>
To: Exec Leadership <leadership@redwood.example>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.example>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.example>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.example>
Date: Sun, 22 Jul 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exec preflight: OKR status + QBR action list

Team —

Quick preflight ahead of Tuesday's QBR. Below is a concise wins / risks / asks snapshot plus concrete owners for the exec packet and the pre-read. I attached the draft QBR deck and a CSV extract of the OKR dashboard. Please read and flag any hard objections by EOD Monday.

Wins:
- Serving runtime: 15% reduction in p50 inference latency across our 8k token profile after kernel switch (benchmark attached). Owner: Infra — Diego (done, rolling metrics look stable).
- Redwood Optimize pilot with Beta Retail: 22% token-cost reduction for embedding-heavy queries (pilot closed-loop measurement). Owner: Product — Laura (report attached).
- Dedicated capacity availability improved — we reduced cold-start incidents to <1% in the past 30 days. Owner: SRE — Jonas.

Risks / Concerns:
- Model validation regressions: a new quantized variant shows a measurable paraphrase drift on our RLHF probe set. Impact: may constrain rollout schedule for Dedicated customers who require pinned model fidelity. Mitigation: freeze rollouts and run targeted evals 7/22–7/25. Owner: Applied ML — Diego & Hannah.
- Procurement timeline: one large EMEA customer (see below) needs updated SLA language for private deployments; legal and procurement will need a 48–72h turn. Ask: can someone from Legal join the Monday huddle? Owner: Sales Ops / Legal (cc'd via pipeline thread).

Asks / Action items (concrete):
1) Laura — consolidate slide 6 (unit economics) with the new Optimize metrics; need final numbers by 2pm PT Monday.
2) Jonas — add a one-slide SLO trend (latency and availability) with 30/60/90 day bands; deliverables by Monday COB.
3) Hannah — run the targeted quantized model eval and post a short summary on the shared doc; estimate: 48 hours.
4) All — review the pre-read deck (attached) and add comments in the Drive file. If you cannot attend Tuesday, mark a delegate to present your section.

Attachments: QBR_prep_deck_v1.pdf (draft), OKR_dashboard_export_2028-07-21.csv (slice)
Links: https://drive.redwood.example/QBR/2028/prep-deck, https://dashboard.redwood.example/okks?week=2028-07-21

Thanks — Diego

--
Diego Fernandez
VP, Operations & Serving Reliability
Redwood Inference
